headline: TEX @ COL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TEX 5.25 at COL 3.92, with a projected total of 9.17. The cold/risk list flags Edouard Julien, Evan Carter because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
